poem.title: 静夜思
poem.author: 李白
poem.text: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。

user_prompt:

Title: 静夜思
Author: 李白
Genre: 五言绝句
Source:

translation:
Thoughts on a Quiet Night

Before my bed, the moonlight glows;
I wonder if it is frost on the ground.
I lift my head to gaze at the bright moon,
then bow it, lost in thoughts of home.
